typeTitle: Commercial explanation of benefits from an employer plan
typeOrientation: portrait for insurer a, landscape for insurer b
typeDescription: An explanation of benefits from a fictional self-funded employer health plan (PPO or HSA-qualified) administered by insurer a or b, with each claim's lines, network status, deductible and out-of-pocket amounts, appeal rights and any No Surprises Act notice.
insurerOption: Fictional insurer that administers the plan: a (portrait, one claim per page) or b (landscape, one table of all claims); commercial-eob only, not for a blind render, drawn from the seed if omitted.
insurerHelp: --insurer a|b  insurer for commercial-eob: a portrait, b landscape (default: drawn from the seed)

messages.insurerType: {who}: the insurer option applies only to the commercial-eob document type.
messages.insurerValue: {who}: insurer must be a or b.
messages.insurerBlind: {who}: insurer cannot be set for a blind render; a blind document's insurer comes from its own seed.
